title: Seeking Australia-UK financial advisor
body:
O.P.
Can anyone recommend a financial advisor with knowledge of both Australian and UK financial landscapes, with specific experience in property, estates, investment, tax in both jurisdictions and superannuation/pension? I'm looking for someone who really knows their stuff and can offer a one-off review and planning session for the next stage in my life. I have asked this question in a similar UK forum, but just seeing if anyone has worked with someone within Australia.
